q1.prompt: On an unweighted graph you need the shortest path in number of edges. Which search?

choices.label: BFS — expand level by level from a queue
DFS — push deep on a stack or recursion

wrong_dfs.prompt: DFS does not guarantee fewest edges.
wrong_dfs.explanation: On unweighted graphs, BFS finds fewest edges. DFS explores depth-first and can find a long path first.

q2.prompt: Which search claim breaks the graph requirement?

choices.label: Do not use DFS for unweighted shortest path; do not omit visited marks on cyclic graphs

wrong_refuse.explanation: Do not use DFS when the metric is unweighted shortest path — BFS belongs there (Dijkstra once weights appear). Do not omit visited marks on graphs that may contain cycles.

success.prompt: You matched BFS to unweighted shortest paths and avoided DFS for that ask.
